copy.blurb:
Argentina face Austria on Monday, evening UTC kickoff, in FIFA World Cup 2026. This is one of the matches where the model's number disagrees with the closing line on Polymarket — one of the widest in the priced field on the Argentina side, +18.9pp.

On Elo, Argentina comes in 310 points ahead — Argentina at 2140, Austria at 1830. Both Elo numbers are pulled live from the public Elo source. The adjustment layer is quiet on this fixture — no host bonus, no home-ground correction, no altitude folding in. The Elo numbers above are what the model uses.

Three-way split from the model: Argentina to win at 76%, the draw at 11%, and Austria to win at 13%. The Desk publishes a three-way read against the same W/D/L resolution Polymarket and Kalshi settle on — not a scoreline guess. Argentina sits at 76% of the mass.

On the same three-way, Kalshi: Argentina to win at 57%, the draw at 25%, and Austria to win at 18%. Kalshi has Argentina at 57%, which prices out at American odds of −133; the model has the same side at 76%. The +18.9pp gap across them is the disagreement we're surfacing.

Pick gate is a lower-bound check, not the point estimate. A 100-sample bootstrap perturbs the Elo prior (±20), the host bonus (±15), and the altitude bonus (±10), then reads the 5th-percentile probability back out. On the Argentina side that lower bound is 66% — +9.3pp clear of the market's 57%, comfortably past our +3pp threshold. The point is selection, not a blanket call. Most matches the model and the market agree on. This is one of the ones where they don't, and the gap is on the Argentina side specifically.

This number will move. The confirmed starting eleven, fitness news, weather at the venue, and any tournament suspension carried in from previous matches all feed back into the prior. With kickoff 27 days out, refresh is weekly; daily cadence picks up inside the final five days. A wide Pick can collapse into a Pass if news moves enough of the read. Editorial analysis only — Odds Primer does not place trades and does not recommend a wager.
